pizza: Pizza was invented in Naples, Italy in the 18th century.
The world's largest pizza was 1261 square metres, made in Rome in 2012.
sushi: Sushi originally referred to fermented fish preserved in rice — the rice was discarded.
Japan consumes about 80% of the world's bluefin tuna.
ramen: Instant ramen was invented by Momofuku Ando in 1958 and is considered Japan's greatest postwar invention.
There are four main ramen styles: shoyu, shio, miso, and tonkotsu.
tacos: The word 'taco' predates the arrival of Europeans in Mexico.
October 4th is National Taco Day in the US.
hamburger: The hamburger is named after Hamburg, Germany, where minced beef patties were popular in the 19th century.
Americans eat about 50 billion burgers per year.
